categories.main_business_segments: Yuexiu Property Company Limited primarily operates in property development, property management, property investment, and related services such as real estate agency and decoration. The company focuses on residential and commercial property development, property leasing, and property management services, including healthcare and elderly care services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced building technologies including green building technologies, prefabricated construction, and energy-saving equipment. It has developed the 'Yue Smart Manufacturing' BIM platform to enhance production efficiency and project quality. Yuexiu also implements the 'Healthy House Technology System' focusing on indoor air quality, natural lighting, noise control, and energy efficiency, aiming for ultra-low energy, near-zero energy, and dual-zero energy consumption buildings.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yuexiu serves residential homebuyers, commercial tenants, and investors in real estate. Its markets include individual property buyers, commercial property tenants, and institutional investors through its real estate investment trust. The company also provides property management and community value-added services to residents and commercial clients, and healthcare services to patients in its healthcare segment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with a focus on tier-1 and tier-2 cities across Greater Bay Area, Eastern China, Central and Western China, and Northern China. Key cities include Guangzhou, Beijing, Shanghai, Hangzhou, Chengdu, and Wuhan. It also has operations in Hong Kong and Macau, with a landbank covering 27 cities in total.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yuexiu operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain, focusing on property development, construction, sales, leasing, and property management. It also engages in upstream activities such as land acquisition and investment in joint ventures and associates involved in property development.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes sustainable development, aiming for net zero emissions by 2060 and carbon peaking by 2030. It focuses on green building technologies, digital transformation including AI integration, and sustainable finance. Strategic priorities include refined management, product innovation, integration of design and construction, and enhancing customer-centric services. It also invests in sustainable finance frameworks and green bonds to support low-carbon transitions.
categories.revenue_model: Yuexiu generates revenue mainly through sales of developed properties, rental income from investment properties, and fees from property management services. Additional revenue streams include real estate agency services, decoration services, and healthcare services. The company also benefits from income from joint ventures and associates, including its stake in Yuexiu REIT.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yuexiu is positioned as a top-10 real estate developer in China by contracted sales value, ranking 8th in 2024. It competes with other major Chinese real estate developers in residential and commercial property markets. The company is recognized for its product competitiveness and sustainable development leadership, distinguishing itself with innovative green building projects and integrated property services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Yuexiu reported revenue of approximately RMB86.4 billion, a 7.7% increase year-on-year, with total assets of RMB410.45 billion and shareholders’ equity of RMB55.26 billion. Contracted sales value was RMB114.54 billion, ranking 8th nationally. Despite a decrease in profit attributable to equity holders to RMB1.04 billion, the company maintains a healthy financial position with a net gearing ratio of 51.7% and investment-grade credit ratings.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yuexiu emphasizes high-quality, customer-centric property development with a focus on sustainable, healthy living environments. Its '4×4 High-Quality Product Concept' and 'Yue Healthy House System' integrate green technology, smart safety, and comfort. The company differentiates through its commitment to sustainable architecture, digital innovation, refined management, and comprehensive community services, aiming to create better urban living experiences and long-term value for stakeholders.
